flat.label: Track floor occupancy and swaps
flat.observed: An occupied destination exchanges colors while a vacancy changes the footprint.
flat.construct: Arrange two paths with the same destination color and different source cells. Vary repeated colors deliberately; replay all visible cells.

stack.label: Track supported stacks
stack.observed: Withdrawing a support can settle the stack before the next address is read.
stack.construct: Put an upper cube over the movable support. Move the base sideways into a supported vacancy. A foil keeps it suspended or selects the wrong color on the next step. Inspect both views.

checkpoint.label: Choose a path using its intermediate stack
checkpoint.observed: Different valid sequences can end in the same configuration.
checkpoint.construct: Create two legal routes with equal final stacks and a different settled first state. Retain that checkpoint and compare outcomes with it omitted.
checkpoint.extension: The additional observed state is a harness extension.

missing.label: Infer a missing first instruction
missing.observed: Destinations and support change the effect of later operations.
missing.construct: Hold a suffix fixed. Vary the initial withdrawal so subsequent commands see different settled occupants. Replay each complete program against the visible board.
missing.extension: Inferring the missing prefix is a harness extension.
